post.summary: Adds a task to the specified job.
post.description: The maximum lifetime of a task from addition to completion is 7 days. If a task has not completed within 7 days of being added it will be terminated by the Batch service and left in whatever state it was in at that time.

get.summary: Gets information about the specified job.
